title: Its Nice Being Third Heavy Cotton T-Shirt, Anime Style Solar System Tee, Funny Astronomy Gift
intro:
It’s nice being third.

The Sun, Mercury, Venus, and Earth appear in a colorful anime-style lineup, with a quiet joke about Earth’s place as the third planet from the Sun. Bold lettering and richly illustrated planets give this astronomy design a playful look.

A fun conversation starter for astronomy lovers, science teachers, STEM students, and anyone who enjoys an understated space joke.
